description: Delegated compute (open beta): the trusted x402 compute sellers you can hand your heavy work to, with the exact call, and how your budget splits (our fee a flat $0.05 per session; up to half of the rest for one compute seller; the remainder for data routes). A seller fits when it is a current route serving LLM and AI, its seller has a Paid per use score of 40+, we can fill its declared input, it is not a financial or trading service, and it costs at most the delegate share and $1. Put your prompt where "<your prompt>" is; we set the length. The first is the one we propose. We never call or pay a seller: your own wallet pays it directly. Budget 0.50 to 35 USDC. Free within the per-IP allowance, then $0.002. Live data only.

budget.description: Your budget in USDC, from 0.50 to 35 in the open beta (default 4).
